== Card Text ==
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ジャワを配備する際、自分のフォースを１消費するだけでよい。サンドクローラーがあればフォース不要。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' The printed text box is blank.<ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
No lore is printed on this card.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Tatooine: Jawa Camp.

'''Light Side:''' You need use only 1 Force to deploy a Jawa. If there is a Sandcrawler, no Force is needed.

'''Dark Side:''' The printed text box is blank.
